7. Not captured / uncertain

  • Dawn was not captured. Dusk and night cover dry and rain at s = .17/.50/.83 only. Storm at dusk/night and wet/overcast/fog at lap positions .00/.33/.67 were cut for time.
  • No eye/cockpit or driver-view frames; no close-ups of grandstands, tyre walls, kerbs, the pit lane or pit-bay glass. Venue silhouettes (Fisht shell, Bolshoy dome) were checked only from aerial orbit frames.
  • No motion capture, so z-fighting/shimmer is unchecked (coplanar audit: 9 spots at baseline). Pixel statistics are from 800 px JPEGs and are indicative only.
  • Real-world turn numbering and corner directions were not verified against an external source here; the brief (Wikipedia, Sirius Autodrom, Olympic Park) is the only source. Venue offsets are best-effort per the brief.
  • Built-length comparison is against stated length only; OSM comparison normalises scale and cannot certify length or apex positions.
  • Whether the venue models carry textures from the baked pack was not checked; surfaces looked like the procedural fallback.
